scope: Actual Affect Mind deployment onto Obi-Wan against 1/2/3/4 opposing ability; paid cost, attachment, individual vs total ability, ordinary ability present, presence and control. Actual deployment plus controlled Dark Jedi ability/movement checks. A controlled host ability change during deployment verifies selected target retention. Actual Molator action after Affect Mind uses unreduced ordinary present ability. Ten synthetic grants exercise production aggregate add/reset/reduction-prevention/battle-destiny ordering.
references: AR p103 Affect Mind erratum: while present at a site. Pinned Card1_043 omits the explicit site wording; all actual reference boards here are ground sites.
AR p29: modifying or resetting a total does not modify individual cards; Affect Mind and Leia, Rebel Princess are examples.
AR pp43,54: presence and ending battle before damage.
GEMP LocationControl: total additions, battle-destiny-only additions, then lowest eligible reset; reduction prevention skips decreasing general modifiers/resets but not battle-only reductions.
GEMP getTotalAbilityPresentAtLocation intentionally sums individual ability without aggregate modifiers; Card1_225 uses that query to bound payment.
limits: Current ground engine; no vehicles/aboard/captured/inactive or crossing-over behavior claimed. Host leave/return and movement while pending, source/turn lifetime, unique limits, corruption, early battle ending, Alter and multi-react drain coverage have native tests beyond these reference observations.
